title: Give OLY-B-S7-01 a mechanism: check a study's comparison
summary: Add a pure check in athena-core, modelled on mechanism_explanation.rs, that flags a comparison study which lacks shared concepts mapped across all three systems, a per-mechanism comparison, or a closing essay on building orchestration from prompts. Record it as the mechanism in docs/spec.toml with a measure ending `status: not shown`, since no real three-system study exists yet. Audience: the owner and verifier judging the spec gap list.

defaults_applied.how: The new module gets an integration test, and the criteria require fmt, clippy and test to pass.
The test drives `check` with defective inputs and checks the real spec entry.
The rule is enforced by a pure check function with tests.
One focused module, one test file and one spec entry, with no wiring beyond lib.rs.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: I read crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs, crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs and crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs (line 131 `pub mod mechanism_explanation;`). The entry point is a pure `check` function that reads and runs nothing. The test parses the real docs/spec.toml with `hestia::parse_spec` and checks the entry's owner and measure. I also skimmed crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs, which validates a study's claims. It has no rule about comparison or essay content.
The new code adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not involved.

Existing code: the job extends the S4-01 pattern in crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs and crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs, and reuses hestia::parse_spec and SpecRequirement. It creates crates/athena-core/src/comparison.rs and crates/athena-core/tests/comparison.rs.

The check takes a comparison record as input: a list of shared concepts, each mapped for every one of three named systems; a list of mechanism comparisons, each covering all three systems; and an essay with its text and a prompt-orchestration topic. It returns a Gap for each of these: a concept missing a system, no concepts, a mechanism comparison missing a system, no comparisons, a missing or blank essay, and an essay that is not short. 'Short' is a word cap the producer picks and documents.

Measure: the test file checks complete and defective comparisons plus this spec entry, and names `cargo test -p athena-core --test comparison`. The measure ends `status: not shown`, because the check has not yet run on a real three-system study. S3-01, S3-02 and S4-01 use the same wording.
Governance: neither athena.toml, defaults.toml nor any workflow file needs to change. CHANGELOG.md gets the default entry.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-S7-01 has a mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/comparison.rs and its `check` function (not "none"), keeps owner "Athena", and has a measure that names `cargo test -p athena-core --test comparison` and ends with `status: not shown`.

crates/athena-core/src/comparison.rs exists, is declared in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs, and has a doc comment that lists its limits. Its `check` function reports a gap for each of: a concept not mapped for all three systems, no concepts, a mechanism comparison missing a system, no comparisons, a missing or blank essay, and an over-long essay.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test comparison`. A complete comparison yields no gaps. Each defective input (a missing system in a concept mapping, a missing system in a mechanism comparison, an absent essay, a blank essay, an over-long essay) yields exactly its expected gap. The test also parses the real docs/spec.toml and fails when the S7-01 mechanism is "none" or the measure lacks the command or the `status: not shown` ending, so it fails without the mechanism and passes with it.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` as separate commands, or cite the Athena-recorded checks on the final tree. All pass.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry for this change, and the diff touches no records/ path and no existing entry of docs/decisions.md.

out_of_scope: Writing the real three-system comparison study or the essay itself
Running any of the three systems
Changes to other spec requirements, athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow files
Wiring `check` into the athena CLI or the study capability's rule set
